thread:
Mira Chen: Quick check — SOC2 milestone update. We need final owners for KMS rotation evidence, HSM integration smoke, and audit-log backfill. Can owners drop PR links + a short blocker list?
Sam Ortiz: I can take KMS rotation evidence. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/keystore/pull/4523. Blocker: waiting on vendor cert from HSM provider (expected Wed). Also need one test vector for envelope keys. :hourglass: 
Leo Patel: I’ll own audit-log backfill. Landing change in ingestion schema today, PR `#4601`. Blocker: downstream analytics team needs a mapping table. Pinged @Ana for infra routing. :eyes:
Ana Gómez: Happy to help with routing. Can you paste the failing record example? I can run a staging smoke and wire the elastic sink. Also, where are the SOC2 evidence templates?
Mira Chen: Evidence templates are in the compliance repo: https://git.redwood/compliance/evidence-templates (see `kms-rotation.md` and `auditlog-ingest.md`). For failing record: "user_id missing in legacy events" — Leo, can you add a patch that backfills to `user_id` with `anon:<legacy_id>`?
Leo Patel: Yep — adding small backfill in `ingest-backfill/2026-03-18.sql`. Will include migration in `#4601`. ETA EOD PST.
Sam Ortiz: Quick CI note: keystore PR has a failing unit in `keystore/rotate_test.go` only when HSM emulator is used. Repro locally with `make test-hsm`. If vendor cert delayed, we can flip to emulator + a fallback note in the runbook.
Ana Gómez: I can run `make test-hsm` on staging infra after Leo's backfill lands. Command I'd use: `curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/keystore/v1/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY'` — will capture logs and attach to the evidence bundle. Who should I cc on logs?
Sam Ortiz: CC me and @Mira. Also tagging @Leo for schema-impact logs.
Mira Chen: Ownership summary: Sam = KMS rotation evidence + PR `#4523`; Leo = audit-log backfill + PR `#4601`; Ana = staging smoke + runbook exec. Action: everyone confirm EOD updates in thread.
audit-bot: New checklist version applied to thread — `soc2-evidence-checklist v1.3`. See https://compliance.redwood/checklists/1.3.
Leo Patel: Confirmed, will update `#4601` with migration and add a note referencing `auditlog-ingest.md`. :white_check_mark:
Sam Ortiz: Confirmed, I'll add fallback section to `keystore/rotate.md` and attach test logs once staging run completes.
Ana Gómez: I’ll run the smoke after Leo's migration is merged and upload the `smoke-logs.tar.gz` to the compliance bucket. Will update here when done. :+1:
Mira Chen: Thanks — plan sounds good. If vendor cert slips past Wed, we default to emulator + vendor follow-up ticket. Will reconvene in async thread tomorrow AM if anything blocks.
Sam Ortiz: Ack, will post test results here by EOD.
Mira Chen: Great — tagging this as "milestone: soc2-fieldwork" internally. Thanks team!
